planned_by: Claude (Critic): honest scoreboard after the v5 strict-harness finding
goal:
T79 — the scoreboard separates equal-tools comparisons (honesty). Production 2026-10-30: sealed-v5 matches run with
the original harness gave the single lane a strict hunk-count rule the EvoForge lane does not face; the single lane lost
SV5-AO-02 only for that. A match is "equal tools" when manifest.lanes.single.apply == "tolerant" (prompt Arenas are
tolerant by default; records without "apply" count as strict).
1. evoforge/arena.py summary(): keep every existing field; add "equal_tools": {"scored", "wins", "heldout",
   "cost_cents"} with the same rules (succeeded, winner evoforge/single/tie) over equal-tools matches only.
2. Web: the Arena page scoreboard card and the home scoreboard card show the equal-tools line FIRST (label
   arena.summary-equal-tools, e.g. "Equal tools (fair comparison)": wins, hidden tests, costs), then "All matches"
   (the existing numbers). en + ko. Fits 375px.
